title: Command & Conquer: Yuri's Revenge
notes: gamemd.exe 1.001 (Steam Ultimate Collection, md5 2a1307f6...). Globals from YRpp; offsets verified in the binary.

Kills (fixed in set v4): the kill code at 0x703056 increments the VICTIM house +0x5488 and the killer house +0x5438[victim]; so +0x5434/+0x5488 are units/buildings LOST, and kills are the sums of the 20-slot arrays at +0x53E4/+0x5438 (exactly what the score screen at 0x46DB40 adds up). v3 wrongly used the loss counters as kills.
Live-tested 16 Oct 2026. While a match loads the player record briefly holds garbage (2,097,184 credits etc. for ~2s); the gate rejects it.
Online and modem/LAN games are excluded: CnCNet's gamemd-spawn.exe is never opened, and Vault stops reading gamemd.exe as soon as the Game type watch shows a LAN or online match.

testGuide.title: Start a skirmish
testGuide.detail: Choose Skirmish and start a game against the computer.

testGuide.title: Destroy an enemy unit
testGuide.detail: "Enemy units destroyed by you" goes up, and First Blood pops up.

testGuide.title: Lose one of yours
testGuide.detail: "Your units lost" goes up instead. If the two are swapped, copy the test report to Claude.

testGuide.title: Win a campaign mission
testGuide.detail: "Mission file" shows the mission name and the mission achievement pops when you win.
